labels.shortDescription: Receipt is already void
labels.value: This receipt has already been voided. Look for the receipt that replaced it.

labels.shortDescription: Template body is empty
labels.value: A receipt letter cannot be empty. Type the letter you want donors to read, or restore the one BarnCRM ships.

labels.shortDescription: Gift already carries a receipt number
labels.value: This gift has already been receipted. To correct the receipt, void it and reissue it.

labels.shortDescription: Gift could not be read
labels.value: That gift could not be found, or you do not have access to it.

labels.shortDescription: No active template for this receipt type
labels.value: No receipt letter is switched on for this kind of document. Open Nonprofit Settings, then Receipts, then Receipt templates, and switch one on.

labels.shortDescription: User cannot issue receipts
labels.value: You do not have permission to issue receipts. Ask your administrator for the Giving Staff or Giving Admin role.

labels.shortDescription: User cannot change the receipt letters
labels.value: You do not have permission to change the receipt letters. Ask your administrator for the Nonprofit Admin role, which carries Manage Nonprofit Settings.

labels.shortDescription: Receipt could not be read
labels.value: That receipt could not be found, or you do not have access to it.

labels.shortDescription: Renderer received no content
labels.value: There was nothing to put on the receipt. Check that a receipt letter is switched on.

labels.shortDescription: Organization legal name missing
labels.value: A receipt has to state who issued it. Open Nonprofit Settings, then Organization, and fill in your legal name.

labels.shortDescription: Statements are reissued by running again
labels.value: A year end statement is reissued by voiding it and running statements again for that donor, not from this button.

labels.shortDescription: Configured renderer is not installed in this org
labels.value: The receipt renderer chosen in settings ({0}) is not available in this org. Clear the setting to use the one BarnCRM ships.

labels.shortDescription: Receipt type or year missing
labels.value: A receipt number needs both a receipt type and a statement year.

labels.shortDescription: Number series could not be locked
labels.value: Receipt numbers are in use by another job right now. Wait a moment and try again.

labels.shortDescription: Template could not be read
labels.value: That receipt letter could not be found. Refresh the page and try again.

labels.shortDescription: Configured renderer is not one BarnCRM offers
labels.value: The receipt renderer chosen in settings ({0}) is not one BarnCRM offers. Clear the setting to use the one BarnCRM ships.

labels.shortDescription: Void needs a reason
labels.value: Say why this receipt is being voided. A void needs a reason and a date.
